description: This Java class, CorsConfig, defines centralized Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration for a Spring Boot application. It reads allowed origins from the 'app.cors.allowed-origins' property, allowing the configuration to be dynamically overridden via environment variables, and sets up CORS rules for various HTTP methods, headers, and credentials. The class exposes a bean that registers the CORS configuration for all endpoints.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Java configuration class that provides a CORS configuration bean for the Spring application.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Creates and registers a CorsConfigurationSource bean with allowed origins, methods, headers, and credentials for all paths.
